backdrop.product: MGS MOLA MEGDR megt44n000hb (128 px/deg, 463 m, metres above areoid)
backdrop.labelVerified: 11520 x 5632, MSB_INTEGER 16 bit, 128 px/deg, 44N-0N x 0E-90E, metres above areoid, planetocentric (megt44n000hb.lbl)
backdrop.usedBeyond: samples outside the CTX footprint or farther than 15 km, every 250 m out to 120 km, nearest MOLA cell, same curvature term

fixedParameters.grid: 61 x 61 at 100 m, prior 1-2 km from the waypoint (seed 2021)
fixedParameters.frameRule: NAVCAM_LEFT, same site+drive, full-width (5120 px) strip, |mastEl| <= 8 deg, LTST 9-16 h
fixedParameters.successRule: FIX = error <= 500 m and uncertainty <= 1000 m; WEAK = error < prior offset; else FAILED

assumptions: Truth position AND attitude come from NASA's M20_waypoints.json entry matched by site+drive (not by sol); the waypoint yaw/pitch/roll rotation equals each frame's own attitude quaternion (max matrix element difference 7.3e-07). Waypoint = end-of-drive localization; its own accuracy is not stated by NASA in the file and is assumed to be metres to tens of metres.

Frames: all Navcam-left frames of this site+drive that pass the fixed usability rule; of those a deterministic greedy subset (boresight azimuths >= 40 deg apart, starting at the seed frame, clockwise) is downloaded to stay inside the download budget. 36 frames passed the rule, 5 used. Seed/'single frame' = the earliest-sclk usable frame.

Skyline traced per frame with the SAME settings as the single-frame tests (sigma 1.5 px, threshold 4.0, 5-px median smoothing, >12 px running-median outlier rejection); not tuned. Each frame's columns are converted to true azimuth/elevation with its own CAHVORE model and the waypoint attitude, binned to 2-deg cells (>= 10 traced columns, median elevation); frames are merged per cell by median. Cells with no frame or no accepted trace are NaN (null) and are not scored.

Rover-hardware rule: no azimuth sector is masked. On the development frames the rover deck/RTG appears only in the lowest part of the frame, well below the skyline, so the geometric rule is: nothing masked. Not examined for held-out frames before the run.

Matching: heading known to +-10 deg (11 shifts of 2 deg); one elevation offset per candidate (clipped to +-0.5 deg); terrain closer than 150 m is not used to form the predicted horizon (CTX samples >= 150 m and MOLA only) but every traced azimuth is scored for every candidate (v2; v1 excluded such azimuths per candidate, see README 8b); score = RMS over all valid azimuths. The same near-field and offset rules are used in all four ablation rows; only the frame set and the backdrop change. A candidate must score at least 20 azimuths AND 50% of the valid azimuths: this guard was added after the first development run, in which the single-frame best candidate scored only 20 of 48 azimuths because the near-field rule dropped the rest (a degenerate 'win'). It was not tuned on position error.

Horizon = max over CTX samples (40 m, to 15 km) and MOLA samples (250 m, to 120 km, only outside the CTX footprint or beyond 15 km), Mars curvature term, eye 2 m above the CTX elevation at the candidate. CTX minus MOLA at 400 random points inside the DTM: mean -3.6 m, std 24.9 m, so no vertical offset is applied. MOLA is 463 m/pixel and median-binned: it cannot represent terrain finer than that.
CTX part of horizons_ext is checked equal to skyline.horizons (imported, unchanged) at 24 candidates every run (max difference < 1e-6 deg).
A 20 m DTM cannot contain metre-scale rocks in the foreground; those rows of the skyline are part of the photo but not of the model.
Downloads this run: 0 images (cached ones not counted).
method: Real Navcam frames (NASA/JPL-Caltech raw images), skyline traced and matched against CTX DTM + MOLA horizon; not simulated.
verdict: FIX ACHIEVED (rule fixed before the held-out runs: FIX = error <= 500 m and uncertainty <= 1000 m; WEAK = error below the prior offset). Full method (panorama of 5 frames, 98% of azimuths scored, CTX + MOLA backdrop): error 51 m, uncertainty radius 50 m, min RMS 0.837 deg (prior offset 1757 m). Ablation errors (m): single/CTX 3583, single+MOLA 3583, panorama/CTX 51, full 51. At the waypoint itself the full-method RMS is 0.785 deg (residual median -0.06, 5-95% range -0.99 to +1.62 deg). One position, one run: not a statistical result.
setNote: Originally held-out (v1 run: full method 1600 m / 1581 m, a regression from 51 m CTX-only). Diagnosed afterwards (see scripts/README.md 8b, 'what went wrong at site 33') and the near-field rule was changed (v2: terrain < 150 m ignored in the model horizon, every azimuth scored for every candidate). Because the code was changed after seeing and diagnosing this position, it is a development position from now on.
